Pizza Dip
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 11:18pm

Ingredients




1 lrg cream cheese softened
1 jar pizza sauce
1 small can chopped olives
1 medium onion chopped
1 pkt sliced pepperoni
1 pkt grated cheese for pizza

Preparation

1 Spread cream cheese in bottom of crockpot. Then mix up the pizza sauce, onion, olives and pepperoni and spread on top of the cream cheese. Sprinkle with the pizza cheese and cook on LOW until the cheese on top melts. Serve with tortilla chips. 2 You could add other pizza toppings to this or delete some that are listed.
